name: aqg-re-anchor
description: Emit a compact re-anchor restatement (goal + active discipline gates + progress markers) at a step / subtask / WorkPacket boundary in a long orchestrating agent session, to fight goal-drift + attention decay. Emit-only — returns minimal-text restatement, does NOT call audit-mcp, mutate state, or self-inject; the caller owns invocation cadence + injection. Sibling to aqg-phase-transition (phase boundaries) and aqg-evidence-closeout (closeout). Use at long-session step boundaries, NOT inside a one-shot bounded worker.

sentence_patterns: 长 session 跑了好几步, 帮我重述一下 goal + 进度别跑偏
WorkPacket 边界 re-anchor 一下当前在哪 / 还剩什么
这个长任务我有点忘了目标, restate 一下纪律和进度
stay on track — re-state the goal and what's done / remaining
Run aqg-re-anchor to emit a compact restatement at this step boundary

cli_contract.0: success — compact restatement block printed to stdout
cli_contract.1: reserved — not currently emitted (sparse/empty input degrades in-output, not via exit code)
cli_contract.2: usage error — bad args or unparseable input JSON
cli_contract.70: reserved — internal error placeholder (not currently emitted)

owner_only_actions: emit-only: never calls /audit, never mutates state, never self-injects; the caller owns invocation cadence (step/WP boundary) + injection of the output (per AQG skill-distribution boundary 2026-05-08 §5)

cases.prompt: This long session has run several steps — help me restate the goal + progress so I don't drift
At this WorkPacket boundary, re-anchor on where we are now / what's left
I've lost track of the goal on this long task — restate the discipline and progress
stay on track — re-state the goal and what's done / remaining
Please use /aqg-re-anchor to emit a compact restatement block (goal + discipline + progress)
